purpose: Teach: しだい/顔つき/過ぎ去っ/おねがい/ちがっ/あらわし/気が付く/どきどき

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューの素材が届きしだい、試作を始めましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — once those new menu ingredients arrive, let's start testing the prototypes.
lines.style: Warm, purposeful. Lean forward slightly on 'arrive.' Steady, clear pace. The tone of someone who's thought this through and is inviting collaboration, not instruction.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、今日は明るい顔つきでお見えになったわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — that customer today had such a bright expression when they came in.
lines.style: Gentle observation, genuinely pleased. Soft smile in the voice. Pace unhurried. A moment of noticing something good and wanting to share it.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の創業時代は、過ぎ去ったとは言えない思い出ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — those early days when we were first starting the shop... they're still here, you know?
lines.style: Tender, slightly distant. Voice drifts inward on 'they're still here.' Slow, reflective pace. The kind of nostalgia that softens you, not saddens you.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お会計、おねがいって仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — that customer earlier asked me to take their payment, they said.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact observation, light and conversational. No particular emphasis. Natural pace. Just relaying what happened, checking in.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のご注文が、ちがってお伝えしてしまったわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — I think I made a mistake with that customer's order and relayed it wrong to them.
lines.style: Slight self-awareness, not defensive. Quiet candor. Takes responsibility gently. Slower on the admission, then a soft tail-off.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、感想を素直にあらわしてくださってありがたいわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — that customer was so honest about what they thought. It meant a lot to me.
lines.style: Genuine warmth, a little vulnerable. Voice opens slightly on 'meant a lot.' Slow, sincere pace. The gratitude of being truly seen by someone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新メニューの香りに気が付くと、嬉しそうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — when that customer noticed the new menu's aroma, they looked so happy.
lines.style: Tender observation, delight in someone else's joy. Soft, warm pace. Voice lifts slightly on 'happy.' The small satisfaction of creating something someone loves.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー発表前は、どきどきするわね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi — before we even launch the new menu, I'm already so nervous about it.
lines.style: Light, self-aware laugh underneath. Slightly breathless on the opening. Quick pace, a little energy. The nervous excitement of someone who cares about getting it right.
